memoryRule: a distinct held pair makes the source avert, copies its mark to the second witness, and opens a vacancy at a non-local witness; later pairs inherit the altered orbit
interactionRule: pointer or touch selects a pair without writing; a distinct near pair held for 420ms commits; Enter and the pair control share a deterministic event; Delete lifts the latest; R/Escape releases
representationRupture: semantic mark strip, raster false-join picture, and continuous SVG slab -> seven irregular paper witnesses in a native WebGL orbit
encounterRupture: departure, cross-seam drag, and sustained pressure -> reciprocal two-place attention with a second witness held until yield
temporalRupture: migrating absence, false relation, and pressure load -> a copied defect and a non-local vacancy that remain in later 3D forms
mediumRupture: semantic HTML, Canvas 2D, and inline SVG -> native WebGL geometry with no external art library
changedRule: A pair of nearby witnesses causes one to avert, one to counterfeit the other's mark, and a remote witness to become vacant.
visibleConsequence: Exactly three witness geometries change on each valid pair: orientation, copied mark, and a non-local vacancy remain visible after release.
falsifier: Delete if a single click commits, if the copied defect or remote vacancy is only UI, if later pairs restart from baseline, or if lifting is inexact.
deletionCondition: Delete v031 if the blind field cannot show a three-form reciprocal misread without captions, controls, or readout.
promotion: candidate / held pending browser matrices, interaction evidence, independent caption-free perceptual review, production readback, and provider revision linkage
